title: UX Engine: Improving AI-Generated Interfaces
summary: This reel introduces UX Engine, a tool for Claude Code that transforms generic 'database-shaped' AI outputs into user-centric interfaces. It emphasizes intent discovery, state completeness, and automated UX auditing to create safer, more professional designs.

transcript.text: 12 columns, every field in the schema. Delete sits next to edit on every row.
No empty state, no loading state. One misclick from disaster.
This one gets rebuilt live. One command.
It asks who uses this page and what's the worst mistake they could make.
Support team, wrong account deletes. So delete moves behind a type confirmation.
Search becomes the primary action. 5 columns, not 12.
It specs every state before writing code. Loading, empty, error, success, offline, partial.
The skeleton matches the final layout.
Already shipped? Point the auditor at any screen.
You get a severity-ranked fix list, not advice.
Six skills, two sub-agents, three commands. Senior designer reasoning on every prompt.
It's called UX Engine built for Claude Code. Link in bio, save this before your next build.

before_after: A cluttered 12-column table with immediate delete buttons is transformed into a streamlined 5-column table with search-first navigation and confirmation-guarded destructive actions.
